# Maximize measures the workspace root when no dock host is named, so chrome outside the dock area is covered

## Context

Found while verifying #18305 (PR #18324) on `examples/dashboard/dock`: engaging maximize paints the pane over the example's perspective toolbar. The measurement resolves `owner.getDockHost()`, which is the workspace itself when no `dockHostReference` is set (`src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs`, `getDockHost()`), and the example sets none. The measurement code is the pre-existing Workspace code moved verbatim into the plugin; dev behaves the same.

Prior decision this challenges: #18122 (PR #18124, 2026-09-02) moved the measurement from the workspace root to `getDockHost()`, which fixed the Workstation (it names its host) and left the root as the fallback for host-less consumers because the component fixture's host is the workspace itself. The fixture's root and shell share a rect, so the fallback never showed there; a host-less consumer with chrome outside the shell is where it shows.

## The Problem

The maximize contract (the `measureRect` docblock) says: "A maximized pane fills the DOCK AREA, not the app view: a workspace that frames its host with a tour bar or a status bar keeps them in sight." That holds only for consumers that name a host — `apps/workstation/view/Workspace.mjs:140` and `examples/dashboard/choreography/DemoAWorkspace.mjs:71` set `dockHostReference: 'dock-host'`. A consumer that lets the workspace host the projected shell directly — `examples/dashboard/dock/MainContainer.mjs`, whose perspective toolbar sits at index 0 and whose shell sits at `dockShellIndex: 1` — gets the workspace root measured. Live on a dev server at PR #18324's head: the maximized node painted `{x: 8, y: 8, w: 1264, h: 704}` (the 1280×720 root inset by the 8px gap token) while the projected shell (`.neo-dashboard-dock-edge-zone.neo-dashboard`, `neo-container-1`) sits at y=42 under the 42px toolbar.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Workspace#getDockHost()` — `dockHostReference ? this.getReference(dockHostReference) : this`. The host is the container the projection mounts INTO; the projected shell is `getDockHost().items[dockShellIndex]`.
- `plugin/Maximize#measureRect()` (from PR #18324) — `id = owner.getDockHost()?.id || owner.id`, `DomAccess.getBoundingClientRect` on that id, `rectStyle` insets it by `--dock-maximize-gap`.
- The FLIP (`captureFirst` / `playFlip`) queries markers under `getDockHost().id` — a container scope, unaffected by which element is measured.
- Witnesses: `test/playwright/component/dashboard/DockMaximize.spec.mjs` (`maximizedRectMatchesHost` compares against `#dock-maximize-workspace .neo-dashboard`, i.e. the SHELL, inset by the gap — green today only because the fixture's root and shell share a rect); `test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationNL.spec.mjs` (host inset by the gap; the Workstation names a host).

## The Fix

Measure the dock AREA, not the mount point: in `Maximize#measureRect`, when `getDockHost()` is the owner itself, measure the projected shell `owner.getDockHost().items?.[owner.dockShellIndex]`; keep the named host when one exists (its rect is the consumer's stated dock area) and the root as the last fallback while nothing is mounted. Red-first: a component arm on a fixture whose workspace frames the shell with a toolbar and names no host — the maximized rect must match the shell inset by the gap, and the toolbar's rect must stay uncovered.

Alternative rejected: making the example name a host fixes one consumer and leaves the engine's documented contract false for every other host-less consumer.

## Contract Ledger Matrix

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Maximize#measureRect` | the maximize contract in its own docblock; #18122's host decision | measures the named host, else the projected shell at `dockShellIndex`, else the owner root | root while nothing is mounted (unchanged) | the `measureRect` docblock | new component arm; the existing host-inset arms stay green |

Decision Record impact: none — ADR 0029 does not specify the maximize geometry authority.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A host-less workspace that frames the shell with chrome maximizes onto the shell rect inset by the gap token, and the chrome stays visible — component arm, red-first against the current root measurement.
- [ ] The Workstation e2e arm (named host) and the existing `DockMaximize.spec` host-inset arms stay green.
- [ ] `examples/dashboard/dock`: maximize keeps the perspective toolbar in sight — live receipt in the PR body.

## Out of Scope

- The gap token, the shadow and the reduced-motion policy (#18122 settled them).
- Any other Workspace concern (#18304 leaves).
